name: deterministic external proposal composition
implementation: original mlx2 integration using existing MIT prompt-lookup and native-MTP protocols
modifications: Explicit revision-bound external policy with PLD then optional bounded private native-MTP then external arbitration
External backbone maintains committed feature caches before selected point-mass proposals replace rows
Reconstruct copy index solely from committed history and current anchor each round
Adapter-owned native-MTP teacher forcing and full-vocabulary greedy chain using fresh private target and head caches, discarded on success or failure
Invalidate current external confidence proxy for substituted rows; unchanged exact target rejection verification

validation.cpu: 19 focused composition cases and 42 combined composition/adaptive/APCv2 cases passed on CPU; Ruff passed for new source and tests

limitations: Native-MTP private recomputation is bounded and does not publish a paired persistent MTP sidecar
Stochastic external and paired-context-token backends fail closed
DPara remains a single-request research candidate and can consume selected spines without a serving route
